workout.warmup: 8-10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%). Band pull-aparts x 20. Ramp the shoulder press light: 30s x 8, 40s x 5, then work at 50. Ramp the bench when you get to it: 135 x 8, 165 x 3.
workout.coach_note: ORDER CHANGED TODAY - shoulder press goes FIRST. You owned 55 lb for 4x6 on Jul 18 and it has collapsed to one good set every session since, and the constant every time was that it ran second, right behind the heavy bench. Today you press while you're fresh, at 50 for sets of 8. That is not a downgrade, it is the volume base this lift never got. Own 50 x 4x8 and 55 comes back next session in this same lead slot. Bench holds at 185 - you earned it Sunday, but it is running second for the first time so complete it before you add to it. One flag from Monday: your lower back got tired on RDL set 4 AND again on the hip thrusts. You stopped both at the right moment, which is exactly the judgment I want. But that is the signal to consolidate, not climb - your RDL jumped 205 to 235 in a single session. Next lower day we hold and clean it up.
workout.finisher: Skip if you're at 65 min. Otherwise 10-12 min incline walk.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press [HEAVY] - LEAD LIFT
exercises.note: First lift of the day, fully fresh - this is the whole experiment. 50 for four sets of EIGHT, not six. You did 6/7/6 at 50 last time while already fatigued from benching, so 4x8 fresh is real work and right at the edge. Setup: sit upright with back support, DBs on your thighs, kick one knee at a time to drive each up. Do not muscle them from a dead hang. If all four sets hit 8, we test 55 in this slot next upper day.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 185 lb (45 bar + 70/side) - 4 x 5. No rack: Smith at 185 total / 80 per side
exercises.note: HOLD at 185. You got 5/5/5/4 on the free bar Sunday and it is your first time running bench in the second slot, so the job is completing 4x5 - not adding. Ramp 135 x 8, 165 x 3. Free barbell whenever a rack exists; the Smith at 80/side is the fallback. If set 4 comes up short again, that is fine and expected with the new order.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row [HEAVY]
exercises.note: You took a clean 4x6 at 160 on Sunday and the only reason it wasn't 165 is the machine had no 5 lb increment. 170 is the honest next step. Chest supported, controlled, no yanking with the low back - especially this week.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown [HEAVY]
exercises.note: 150 for 6 on sets 1, 2, 3 last time, then 140 for 7 on set 4. Close it out at 150 for all four today. Use the neutral-grip lat bar you found - wide metal bar with the ring handles. Full stretch at the top, elbows down to the ribs.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.note: Bumping from 37.5 - you got all three sets of 15 clean. Four consecutive sessions completed now, the skipping pattern is gone. Elbows high and wide, pull to the forehead, pause a beat at the back. Best insurance you have for the mid-back.

exercises.name: Arms Superset - EZ-Bar Curl + Rope Pushdown
exercises.detail: EZ-Bar Curl 50 lb x 10 + Rope Pushdown 42.5 lb x 12 - 3 rounds
exercises.note: Rotating off Sunday's rope hammer curls. EZ-bar at 50 gave you 10 then 12 on Jul 29. Pushdowns up from 37.5. If no EZ-bar is free, rope hammer curls at 37.5 are the fallback. Elbows pinned on both.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Cable Crunch 42.5 lb x 12, Bird Dog x 8/side, Hollow Body Hold 25 sec
exercises.note: Rotated off both recent circuits. Bird dog is deliberate this week - it's back-safe and your lower back took a beating Monday. Pause a full second at the top. Skip the hollow body hold if the low back complains at all.
